parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
><notice> **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description:
The property information to set, in JSON format.

Each property is represented as a key-value pair of the identifier and property value. Separate multiple properties with commas.

For example, to set the following two properties of a smart light:

- The switch property with the identifier **Switch**, data type **Bool**, and value **1** (on).

- The light color property with the identifier **Color**, data type **String**, and value **blue**.

The JSON format of the property information is as follows:

`Items={"Switch":1,"Color":"blue"}`

> To set properties of a custom module testFb (non-default module), use the following format: `Items={"testFb:Switch":1,"testFb:Color":"blue"}`

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.name: Qos
parameters.description:
The message delivery method when calling this operation. Valid values:

- **0** (default): at most once.
- **1**: at least once. If a QoS=1 message does not receive a PUBACK message, the message is pushed to the device again when the device reconnects.
